notes: It is the Moabitish damsel: the explicit hi takes only It and the copula joins the predicate noun (rule 20); the supplied the joins that noun under rule 15.

The English looks like a cleft, but rule 20's cleft ruling does not reach it: every word answers to a morpheme — It to hi, that to the attributive article on ha-shavah (rule 41) — so nothing here is added.
came back keeps its particle with the verb, bare came not writing the returning (rule 44).
